name: service-start-hero
title: Service start hero
description: The start page of a service: what it is, how long it takes, what to have ready and one clear Start button, in plain text with no image.
docs: The title is an h1 by default, because the start page of a service is a page of its own; pass titleAs="h2" inside a page that has its own. The Start button is a link to the first step; a longer label, in another language, wraps to a second line instead of being cut off. updatedAt takes a Date or a day written "2026-10-21" and is shown in a time element.
